screenshotPrompts.label: Whisper app entry
screenshotPrompts.screenDescription: The normal Whisper first screen after launch: the branded W splash, sign-in form, Reconnect to Whisper recovery, or the existing member's home screen. Capture the actual current entry state without navigating or changing session/data. This is startup diagnosis, not a particular signed-in destination.
screenshotPrompts.prompt: Raw normal-launch evidence only. No fixture, sign-in, account switch, clearing storage, posting or navigation. Observe the app entry after ordinary launch. If the app exits, return the actual launch failure or crash evidence; do not bypass the startup path.
